title: A Murder Conspiracy Shakes Ravnica
summary: Kellan helps investigators uncover a conspiracy amid the guilds’ post-invasion tensions.
narrative: After arriving from other planes, Kellan joins Kaya and detective Alquist Proft as they investigate high-profile murders.
The case reaches deep into Ravnica’s guild politics and unresolved injuries from the Phyrexian war.

The investigation takes place in a city whose institutions had already endured the War of the Spark and the later Phyrexian invasion. That history shaped what the investigators could assume about witnesses, loyalties, and the possibility that familiar authorities were concealing their own injuries.

Alquist Proft's work emphasizes the difference between evidence of an action and proof of a person's willing participation. The case involves deceptive appearances and coercive influence. Examining that distinction prevents the initial suspicion surrounding figures such as Etrata from becoming a substitute for a full explanation of the murders.

The eventual trail to Oba, one part of Trostani, makes the story both a detective mystery and an account of grievance after war. Kellan's participation also shows a new consequence of the Omenpath era: someone from another plane can become involved in local civic conflict without belonging to its older planeswalker elite.
